controller.name: CCD IK
controller.reads: the measured joint angles, every 50 ms tick
controller.given: the true geometry: forward kinematics, joint axes and origins
controller.internal_model: none: CCD is solved afresh from the measured state every tick (reactive)
controller.rule: cyclic coordinate descent, wrist to base, closed-form combined position-orientation angle per joint (Wang & Chen 1991), joint limits clamped, up to 50 sweeps per tick
